_doc: Top-down figures for the Unity client: height — how tall the picture is on the screen in metres (figures are drawn larger than life, as in Grim Soul: a man is 2.4). The file name is fig-<the key of the portrait> (content/art/mobs.json, npcs.json), so a monster or a person gets their figure as soon as it is drawn; fig-hero-m and fig-hero-f are the hero.
